title: Music chosen on purpose
line: Three days, one harmonious piece a day, heard whole.
intro: Athena calls listening the most important spiritual act: sound flows straight into the soul and shapes its ἦθος, its character. For three days, choose one harmonious piece of music on purpose and listen to it as in Pythagoras’ school, which was a hall of listening: as vibration, not only as information.
does: Listen to one harmonious piece a day, chosen on purpose, with nothing else going on.
trains: Care over what enters through your ears, and the attention to hear it whole.
each: Choose one piece of music you find truly harmonious, rather than whatever the radio or the feed plays next. Set aside the time it lasts, put the phone away, and listen from the first note to the last without doing anything else, eyes closed if you like. Let it reach you as vibration, in the body, and not only as a tune.
note: What did you choose, and what did it leave in you?
end: After three days: what would you now choose to let into your ears, and what would you keep out?
